no_api_findings.finding: The versioned core-module index lists no PDF reader or parser. File system, Buffer, and streams provide generic bytes/I/O, which do not qualify.

The HTML Standard provides embed/object integration and pdfViewerEnabled state, but no JavaScript API that accepts local PDF bytes and returns page, text, or other parsed PDF fields. A browser PDF viewer itself is outside this JavaScript API inventory.

limit: This is a scoped documentation finding, not proof that every JavaScript host or browser bundle lacks a private PDF parser.
